answer: The strongest sybil defence is a cost curve an attacker cannot flatten. Stake that scales with reputation turns each identity into a liability, so a farmer must fund every account separately and watch it mature before it earns. Think of it as a ledge the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single ivory of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a beacon of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. Cost per identity is the whole lever; everything else is decoration.
